scope: 23 clarified or newly distinguished primary-source claims; not a new count of nonoverlapping unique teachings. Passage selected and checked in English; German comparison still pending.

records.paraphrase: Steiner distinguishes respiratory/chest processes involving the physical and etheric members primarily, from I and astral influences appearing as imprints.
records.scientific_boundary: Steiner's historical/esoteric account; unsupported medical claims not treatment advice

records.paraphrase: The silica process is described as having comparatively strong material expression in the head but stronger force activity in the metabolic-limb domain.
records.scientific_boundary: Steiner's historical/esoteric account; unsupported medical claims not treatment advice

records.paraphrase: The head's differentiating activity is said to enable distribution of formative influences to distinct organs including heart and liver.
records.scientific_boundary: Steiner's historical/esoteric account; unsupported medical claims not treatment advice

records.paraphrase: He contrasts the constructive role attributed to silica in hair and magnesium in teeth with their presence in substances said to be eliminated.
records.scientific_boundary: Steiner's historical/esoteric account; unsupported medical claims not treatment advice

records.paraphrase: The I-imprint is described as a dynamic system of forces seen in movement, equilibrium and differentiated head warmth, not a static anatomical cast.
records.scientific_boundary: Steiner's historical/esoteric account; unsupported medical claims not treatment advice

records.paraphrase: He warns against picturing the etheric body as an undifferentiated cloud, explicitly comparing it to the differentiated stomach, heart and liver.
records.scientific_boundary: Steiner's historical/esoteric account; unsupported medical claims not treatment advice

records.paraphrase: Names warmth, light, chemical and life ethers as distinct categories; chemical ether should not be treated as ordinary chemical synthesis.
records.scientific_boundary: Steiner's historical/esoteric account; unsupported medical claims not treatment advice

records.paraphrase: Treats the aqueous part of the head as organized rather than mere unstructured water, and presents the eye as formed by light.
records.scientific_boundary: Steiner's historical/esoteric account; unsupported medical claims not treatment advice

records.paraphrase: In sleep, astral and I activity is said to loosen from head and respiration while penetrating more deeply into metabolic and circulatory organization; Steiner explicitly rejects a simple whole-body exit model.
records.scientific_boundary: Steiner's historical/esoteric account; unsupported medical claims not treatment advice

records.paraphrase: Explicit four-term schematic aligns physical with nutrition, etheric with health, astral with illness, I with death; this is a historical metaphysical schema, not actual disease causation.
records.scientific_boundary: Steiner's historical/esoteric account; unsupported medical claims not treatment advice

records.paraphrase: Steiner describes physical and etheric processes as intimately joined in chest organs, which the astral and I allegedly can enter or permeate.
records.scientific_boundary: Steiner's historical/esoteric account; unsupported medical claims not treatment advice

records.paraphrase: Chest rhythmic activity is positioned as receiving influences from head, metabolism and exterior environment rather than originating solely within chest tissues.
records.scientific_boundary: Steiner's historical/esoteric account; unsupported medical claims not treatment advice

records.paraphrase: Steiner treats germs as signs rather than primary causal agents in a discussion of illness; this conflicts with established infectious-disease science.
records.scientific_boundary: Steiner's historical/esoteric account; unsupported medical claims not treatment advice

records.paraphrase: Steiner claims living thoughts pre-exist individuals in a universal ether from which the developing etheric organization receives them.
records.scientific_boundary: Steiner's historical/esoteric account; unsupported medical claims not treatment advice

records.paraphrase: He describes the brain and nervous system as reflectors, not originators, of ordinary thoughts; his claim of continual nerve 'death' is not accepted neurobiology.
records.scientific_boundary: Steiner's historical/esoteric account; unsupported medical claims not treatment advice

records.paraphrase: He proposes teacher–child relations in which a teacher's next-higher member acts upon the child's given member; not an anatomical creator map.
records.scientific_boundary: Steiner's historical/esoteric account; unsupported medical claims not treatment advice

records.paraphrase: He interprets inability to turn intention into action in a child as an effect of allegedly inadequately developed etheric activity in the liver.
records.scientific_boundary: Steiner's historical/esoteric account; unsupported medical claims not treatment advice

records.paraphrase: The I organization is said to enter a direct relation with gravity, earthly physical forces and some warmth during waking life.
records.scientific_boundary: Steiner's historical/esoteric account; unsupported medical claims not treatment advice

records.paraphrase: Eye is portrayed as a boundary organ bringing astral and I organization into direct relationship with external physical processes.
records.scientific_boundary: Steiner's historical/esoteric account; unsupported medical claims not treatment advice

records.paraphrase: Steiner claims skull configurations and a spleen-related blockage correspond to moral character; phrenology and such causal claims are scientifically invalid and stigmatizing.
records.scientific_boundary: Steiner's historical/esoteric account; unsupported medical claims not treatment advice

records.paraphrase: Steiner treats alleged astral/I retention at an organ surface as a cause of convulsions or pain, a false medical theory.
records.scientific_boundary: Steiner's historical/esoteric account; unsupported medical claims not treatment advice

records.paraphrase: He describes excessive permeability of an organ surface to astral/I activity as a separate polarity from congestion and relates it to bodily secretions.
records.scientific_boundary: Steiner's historical/esoteric account; unsupported medical claims not treatment advice

records.paraphrase: He attributes childhood bedwetting to astral activity 'leaking out'; this is not a supported medical explanation and must not be offered as diagnosis.
records.scientific_boundary: Steiner's historical/esoteric account; unsupported medical claims not treatment advice
